title: Granite Appoints Stan Bass to Board of Directors
summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE: GVA) announced today the appointment of Stan Bass to its Board of Directors, effective November 17, 2026.With more than 30 years of leadership experience in construction materials, operations, strategic growth, and business development, Mr. Bass brings significant industry expertise to support Granite's long-term strategy and continued expansion of its vertically integrated construction materials platform.
body_markdown:
WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE: GVA) announced today the appointment of Stan Bass to its Board of Directors, effective November 17, 2026.


With more than 30 years of leadership experience in construction materials, operations, strategic growth, and business development, Mr. Bass brings significant industry expertise to support Granite's long-term strategy and continued expansion of its vertically integrated construction materials platform.


Mr. Bass retired from Vulcan Materials Company in April 2026 after serving as Chief Strategy Officer. Before serving as Chief Strategy Officer, Mr. Bass held numerous executive leadership positions at Vulcan, including Division President, Senior Vice President, and Chief Growth Officer. He also led asphalt and construction operations across multiple markets, providing broad experience across the infrastructure and construction materials value chain. Throughout his career at Vulcan, Mr. Bass played a key role in the company's growth, leading organic and acquisition-driven expansion efforts that strengthened its position as the nation's largest producer of construction aggregates.


"Stan's deep experience in aggregates, strategic growth, and commercial excellence will bring valuable perspective to our board," said Granite Board Chair Mike McNally. "His proven track record of creating shareholder value through disciplined growth, acquisitions, and operational leadership aligns well with Granite's strategic priorities and will help guide our continued expansion as a vertically integrated infrastructure and materials company."


Mr. Bass earned a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from Virginia Military Institute and completed the Advanced Management Program at The Wharton School. He has also served on the board of the National Asphalt Pavement Association.


**About Granite**


Granite is America’s Infrastructure Company™. Incorporated since 1922, Granite (NYSE:GVA) is one of the largest diversified construction and construction materials companies in the United States as well as a full-suite civil construction provider. Granite’s Code of Conduct and strong Core Values guide the Company and its employees to uphold the highest ethical standards.
